Expeditions

Reef Check California

Measuring the shape of underwater study plots

Explore the work

ProjectsResearchExpeditionsDiscuss a project

Location: Monterey, California.

Year: 2021.

Organization: Reef Check California.

My role: underwater photogrammetry surveys and surface-area estimation from 3D reconstructions.

I conducted underwater photogrammetry surveys for an urchin remediation study. Using 3D reconstructions, I estimated the surface area of rugose study plots: plots with uneven, complex surfaces.

Supporting the study

My contribution focused on documenting the plots and estimating their surface area from reconstructed geometry.

From field images to measurements

Underwater photographs provided the source material for the 3D reconstructions. The reconstructed surfaces provided a basis for estimating plot area.
